title: Apple Music for Artists skill roadmap

beginner.title: Get started with Apple Music for Artists
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Apple Music for Artists, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Prepare a release
beginner.outcome: You can: get a song ready for stores
beginner.practice: Prepare one finished song with artwork and correct metadata

beginner.title: Your artist profile
beginner.outcome: You can: look professional where fans find you
beginner.practice: Complete your artist profile and link your socials

intermediate.title: Read your numbers
intermediate.outcome: You can: understand who listens and where
intermediate.practice: Write three decisions from last month's stats

intermediate.title: Get paid properly
intermediate.outcome: You can: make sure every earning reaches you
intermediate.practice: Set up payouts and a split with one collaborator

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Apple Music for Artists
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Apple Music for Artists distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Apple Music for Artists
expert.outcome: You can: use Apple Music for Artists's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Plan a release campaign
expert.outcome: You can: turn a release into growth
expert.practice: Run a 4-week campaign for your next single

expert.title: Integrate Apple Music for Artists into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Apple Music for Artists with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Apple Music for Artists to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Apple Music for Artists well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Apple Music for Artists" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
